text:
Mira: hey all, quick help? accepted invites to my personal email by mistake, 1Password link expired and Okta passkey enrollment on my Ubuntu laptop fails with NotAllowedError. yubikey LED blinks but browser stops at "enroll". anyone seen this?
Ben (IT): welcome Mira! i can resend 1Password. for passkeys on Linux: try Chrome, confirm device with lsusb, and disable VPN if you have one. which email did you accept with?
Mira: thanks. used mira+signup@gmail.com (ugh). lsusb shows:
Mira: ```
$ lsusb
Bus 001 Device 004: ID 1050:0407 Yubico.com YubiKey 5/5 NFC
```
Mira: tried firefox and chromium, both show `DOMException: The operation was aborted. (NotAllowedError)` in devtools.
Sam (eng-infra): NotAllowedError often means origin mismatch or Chrome blocked credential. Make sure you're on https://okta.redwood.ai and not a proxy. Also clear site data for the org URL before retry.
onboarding-bot: note  1Password invite resent to mira@redwood.ai at 1891234578.
Ben (IT): i've mapped your personal alias to your work account and resent the 1Password invite. i also toggled the WebAuthn setting off/on for the org as a nudge. try enrolling again in Chrome after clearing site data.
Mira: retried and success! yubikey registered as "mira-yubikey1" and 1Password invite accepted. ssh pubkey imported into 1Password and works. thanks everyone.
Cara (onboarding): adding a quick checklist note: if you accepted with a personal alias ping IT to map it; prefer Chrome for first passkey enroll on Linux; if WebAuthn errors persist IT can toggle the org setting. :memo:
Ben (IT): marked resolved. ping me if your key doesn't unlock ssh or if Okta push/TOTP still acts up. :white_check_mark:
